result: Narrowed; original node status retained. For arbitrary types X, R and D, a report r:X→R and a decision d:X→D admit a unique decoder on the actual image of r exactly when d is constant on every fibre of r. Equal reports with unequal decisions remain an obstruction after every report-only postprocessor. The joint report (r,d) is sufficient for d.
proof_boundary: The maps are declared. The result constructs no evaluator, permission grantor or physical authenticity test. The decoder is classical/noncomputable in general. Unused reports require no default value, and the empty case is included.
